originality.rationale: Primary 2023 aNIMFA paper gives generalized equilibrium equations and no-cycle theorem; the result here is the sharp continuum exponent bifurcation and the independent link-timescale critical slowing law. Comparison with selected earlier response models and published-finding corpus same/different vector-field claims found no theorem implying these combined conclusions; residual priority uncertainty is recorded.
residual_risks: One later multigroup manuscript was not accessible in relevant full text; its abstract was read and substantive coverage judged unlikely but not excluded.

The generic 2023 equation already covers the same response as an admissible specialization. Priority attaches to the new continuous exponent and critical asymptotic theorem, not to introducing an entirely new model or scalar equilibrium identity.
Potential unindexed or unpublished analyses of this exact response or of equivalent center-manifold degeneracy remain possible.

value.rationale: An exact structurally meaningful real response-power cutoff separates epidemic forward-onset and subcritical bistability. At its boundary, every positive-prevalence trajectory has a new universal slow extinction exponent with explicit coefficient independent of link relaxation time; this is motivated by epidemic risk-adaptation nonlinearities and is not a routine numerical parameter slice.
